More than 100 million Tomb Raider games have been sold since. We all remember the good times: the bold design and sheer playability of the original titles; the establishment of Lara as a 90s icon, embodying both lads’ mag culture and girl power; the way she made games cool, even appearing on the cover of the Face. We’ve had blockbuster movies, big budget reboots, and shiny reissues. And who could forget the time we got to powerwash her house? articles.title: How to protect yourself from suspicious messages and scams on WhatsApp
articles.description: WhatsApp has become a significant platform for communication worldwide, yet it is often targeted by scammers. Users are advised to be vigilant regarding messages or calls that appear suspicious or urgent. Scammers may impersonate known contacts or use unknown numbers to deceive individuals. To protect their accounts, users should utilize privacy settings and enable two-step verification. Blocking and reporting suspicious accounts can help mitigate risks associated with online scams.
